unresolved.detail: No 4.4.2 Cho'gall tuning row, client/DBC hash, or Classic hotfix cutoff is published in the audited official notes.
Current guide health is guide-only; 4.2 official reductions and local TDB base row do not establish current four-mode values.
Current guides/local code use +10 Crash/Depravity and 3% room scaling while official 4.2 notes document +5 and 2%.
Local 2/4 target count conflicts with guide 2/5; channel break timing and Twisted Devotion values are not frozen.
Exact alternation, absorb timing, health-to-stack conversion, and four-mode aura coefficients are unresolved.
Local two-add path is 25H-only while guide says heroic; event offsets differ from approximations.
Crash/Depravity radius, damage, interrupts, pool effects, and mode coefficients are not audited against 4.4.2 data.
Pool lifetime, Blood count/health/movement, living spray damage, and exact corruption are incomplete.
Legacy count/guide beam claims do not reconcile with local summon and target relationships.
Local trigger cadence exists but health, knockback, damage, target, and mode scaling do not.
DATA_FULL_HEROIC_ID returns false locally; active retail heroic trapdoor behavior is unproven.
Local helper initialization is explicit but post-evade/reload retail state reconstruction is not validated.
Generic local boss-state paths are known; retail lockout, loot, achievement, Sinestra unlock, and player credit are not established.
